checks.title: Discovering Obscure Looking Glass Sites on the Web to Facilitate Internet Measurement Research
checks.method: Manual program and PDF-header review; independently discovered via OpenAlex
checks.evidence: PDF names Zujiang Pan at Tencent Technology; other authors at Tsinghua University and CETC. Ordered author list agrees with DBLP. PDF keywords independently inspected.

checks.title: Network-Aware and Unsupervised Diagnostics for Latent Issues in Network Management Databases
checks.method: Independent web search; manual official poster author-block review; OpenAlex DOI corroboration
checks.evidence: Official poster listing explicitly gives Li Chen and Hua Shao (Tencent). No academic partner in this author block.

checks.title: Poster: TOO: Accelerating Loss Recovery by Taming On-Off Traffic Patterns
checks.method: Independent affiliation-index discovery; raw indexed authorship inspected; university repository corroboration
checks.evidence: OpenAlex raw publication affiliations give Bo Wu, Cheng Luo and Fuyu Wang at Tencent Technologies; do not substitute its incorrect normalized display names for Xu Yan or Haiyang Wang. University repository agrees with DBLP ordered names, title, DOI, abstract and keywords. PDF affiliation review pending.

checks.title: FIAT: Frictionless Authentication of IoT Traffic
checks.method: Known Tencent author-name lead; manual author-hosted PDF-header review through web-indexed primary PDF text
checks.evidence: Yunming Xiao is listed at Northwestern University; Matteo Varvello at Nokia Bell Labs. Footnote says work done during Nokia internship. A later Tencent-affiliated paper is not evidence for this publication. Web-indexed primary PDF text was accessible; subsequent direct PDF download returned 404, retained in PDF_Checks.

checks.title: An Ultra-Low Latency and Compatible PCIe Interconnect for Rack-scale Communication
checks.method: Known Tencent author-name lead; manual official program author-block review
checks.evidence: Official program lists Jiayu Hu and Cunming Liang at Intel, and the other authors at Fudan University; no Tencent coauthor.

checks.title: Dive into the cloud: Unveiling the (Ab)usage of Serverless Cloud Function in the Wild
checks.method: Manual context review of program Tencent hit
checks.evidence: Tencent appears in the abstract as a measured cloud provider, not in the paper author affiliations. A company mention or Tencent deployment is not coauthorship.

checks.title: ACC: Automatic ECN Tuning for High-Speed Datacenter Networks
checks.method: Independent author-history search and PDF-header review
checks.evidence: PDF assigns authors to Huawei and Nanjing University. An author's earlier Tencent consultancy or later Tencent employment does not establish this paper as Tencent coauthorship.

checks.title: Application Defined Networks
checks.method: Independent web search and official PDF-header cross-check
checks.evidence: A Tencent Cloud community repost is not publisher affiliation evidence; the official PDF has no Tencent in its first two pages.

checks.title: Dorado
checks.evidence: Accepted list versus program differ on Heng Yu, Guozhi Lin and Ziyue Zhai affiliations. Existing program-derived assignments remain provisional; PDF/version reconciliation is still required.

checks.title: Website template reuse
checks.evidence: partials/toc.html on several later-year sites is an unchanged Big-DAMA 2019 TOC, not that year's CoNEXT proceedings. Use the actual program, not the inherited TOC.

scope: 2019-2026; NSDI, SIGCOMM, CoNEXT/PACMNET, IMC, HotNets. ICNP and mobile-centric conferences excluded.
limitation: Neither institution indexing nor program/PDF string scans establish exhaustive recall. Tencent funding-only relationships and affiliated workshops are separate from publication-time coauthorship and have not been swept exhaustively. 2026 is year-to-date.
